title: Iran Knowledge Atlas
sampling: annual published output from a finer-step private simulation
interpretation: Precomputed exploratory outputs. They are not forecasts, measurements, or identified causal effects.
uncertainty: Each scenario includes a structural-sensitivity envelope spanning three alternative acute-breach response structures. The envelope is not a statistical confidence interval.
implementationDisclosure: The equations, coefficients, driver values, event-effect magnitudes, sensitivity implementation, and research source code are intentionally not distributed in this public package.

scenarios.label: Current-era baseline
scenarios.description: Continuation of the current-era private assumptions. This is the reference trajectory for the public scenario gallery.

scenarios.label: No-war control
scenarios.description: An illustrative control with the conflict pathway disabled while other current-era assumptions are retained.

scenarios.label: Education & exchange
scenarios.description: A precomputed exploratory case with stronger education, exchange and institutional conditions and lower conflict/migration pressure.

scenarios.label: Institutional continuity
scenarios.description: A precomputed resilience experiment that strengthens institutional continuity and political stability without publishing the underlying parameterization.

scenarios.label: Skilled-retention case
scenarios.description: An exploratory case with lower outward skilled-migration pressure. It does not yet represent diaspora knowledge exchange or return migration.

scenarios.label: Repeated-shock stress test
scenarios.description: Three illustrative acute shocks test whether repeated disruption can create a persistent cumulative gap before recovery is complete.
